# Staff Backend Engineer, Payments Infrastructure — Globex

Globex is hiring a Staff Backend Engineer to lead the reliability and scale of our payments
infrastructure. You will own the design of our ledger and payout systems, set technical
direction for three teams, and mentor senior engineers.

## You will
- Design and evolve high-throughput, strongly consistent payment systems.
- Lead migrations of critical data stores without downtime.
- Improve on-call health and operational excellence across teams.

## You have
- 8+ years building distributed backend systems (Go, Python or Java).
- Deep experience with PostgreSQL and event streaming (Kafka).
- A record of leading cross-team technical projects.
